change_summary: filter_tools now prunes the exposed tool set to a common retail action allow-list, dropping rarely-used tools from the per-turn schema.
reason_for_change: Tool schemas are re-sent every turn (~27 turns/task), so 13 full schemas are a large fixed per-turn input-token cost. Restricting to the ~11 commonly-used retail tools (dropping transfer_to_human_agents, modify_user_address, and other near-unused tools) shrinks per-turn schema tokens, lowering input tokens and mean cost per task. Guards (size check and non-empty fallback) protect task success as a hard floor.
reason_accepted_or_rejected: rejected: 1 of 2 proxy run(s) failed — crossed success guardrail: pass_rate 0.4167 < floor 0.5410
hypothesis: filter_tools exposes all 13 tools every turn including rarely-used ones (transfer_to_human_agents used once, modify_user_address once); the full tool schema is re-sent each turn inflating input tokens, and pruning to the commonly-used retail action set reduces per-turn schema tokens.
